# simoncos

> Personal site of simoncos / Che ZHAO: software, AI collaboration, data projects, research, essays, talks, music and field notes.

The motto for this site is "connecting the dots." The site is static and bilingual. It has five sections: Index, Articles, Work, Favorites and About. Articles and project pages are one language per file: English pages generally end in `.en.html`; Chinese pages use the same slug without `.en.html`. Section pages carry both languages in the HTML and switch with `?lang=zh`.

## Start here

- [Index](https://simoncos.github.io/): Selected work, then the newest articles and works with a topic filter.
- [About](https://simoncos.github.io/about.html): Short profile, motto and contact links.
- [Apps (应用)](https://simoncos.github.io/projects.html): Every app in one list, live apps first, then those in progress; each opens to its own page or site.
- [Articles](https://simoncos.github.io/blogs.html): Long-form writing archive, filterable by topic, with series.
- [Work](https://simoncos.github.io/gallery.html): One view per type: App, Games, Talks, Research and Music.
- [Favorites (收藏)](https://simoncos.github.io/favorites.html): Every book, film, album and game rated five stars on Douban, newest first, with the short reviews as written there. Page chrome is bilingual; titles and reviews are in Chinese.

## Apps

- [HN Field Notes](https://hn-waywo-dashboard.vercel.app/): Read-only project search, HN source evidence and monthly candidate trends. Updated monthly.
- [HN × LLM: Model Releases and Discussion](https://simoncos-hn-llm-research.vercel.app/): How Hacker News discusses model releases across 14 AI companies, with source threads and coverage limits. An ongoing study.
- [Sleep Toolkit project](https://simoncos.github.io/projects/sleep-toolkit.en.html): Project context, report preview, and routes to the tool and the ten-year sleep research.
- [Sleep Toolkit web app](https://sleep-toolkit-production.up.railway.app): Public tool for SleepCycle CSV analysis.
- [Ten Years of Sleep Records, Analyzed](https://simoncos.github.io/projects/sleep-2016-2026.en.html): Research based on 3,656 nights of personal sleep records, with visual analysis and project context.

## Key artifacts

- [Zhihu 2015: People, Connections and Influence](https://simoncos.github.io/gallery/research/zhihu-2015.html): Bilingual interactive research page comparing the statistics, networks, influence rankings and topics from a 2015 sample. The two original articles remain in Articles.

- [Personal Information Systems in the AI Era](https://simoncos.github.io/gallery/talks/pkm-2026-06-07/index.html): Talk slides on capture, memory, agents, projects, and boundaries. In Chinese only.
- [Hermes Agent HV Analysis](https://simoncos.github.io/gallery/research/hermes-agent-hv-analysis.html): Horizontal-vertical analysis of Nous Research's open-source agent framework, in an evidence-first format. In Chinese only.
- [Endless Echoes (漫无止尽的回响)](https://simoncos.github.io/gallery/music/endless-echoes.html): A game in Work → Games: a branching music riddle through 36 songs, first set in 2017 in Xiami playlist notes and restored from the Xiami archive and its Douban backup.
- [Sunny Day (晴天)](https://simoncos.github.io/gallery/music/qingtian.html): Original song, words, music and vocals by Che Zhao, with the recording, the lyrics, and the score (numbered-notation PDF, MusicXML, MIDI).
- [My Personal Knowledge Management System, 2026-03](https://simoncos.github.io/blogs/my-personal-knowledge-management-system-2026-03.en.html): Essay on personal systems and the publishing layer.
- [My Haba Snow Mountain Journey](https://simoncos.github.io/blogs/my-haba-snow-mountain-journey.en.html): Field note about outdoor experience, risk, and body feedback.
- [Problem Solving and Design](https://simoncos.github.io/blogs.html#series-problem-solving-and-design): Four completed essays in Chinese and English, from problem situations and feasible solutions to open-ended problems, indecision and the optimal solution.

- [Reading Roundups (读书小结)](https://simoncos.github.io/blogs.html#series-reading-roundups): Six bilingual reading roundups from 2015 to 2019, preserving the original reviews and historical dates.

## Data and feeds

- [Agent index JSON](https://simoncos.github.io/agent-index.json): Structured machine-readable map of the site's sections and main works.
- [Site data JSON](https://simoncos.github.io/data/site.json): Source data the Index, Work, project and About pages are generated from.
- [Article index JSON](https://simoncos.github.io/data/article_index.json): Lightweight bilingual article index (titles, dates, excerpts, topics, series and translations).
- [RSS Chinese](https://simoncos.github.io/feed.zh.xml): Chinese RSS feed.
- [RSS English](https://simoncos.github.io/feed.en.xml): English RSS feed.

## Notes for agents

- Prefer English pages when both English and Chinese versions exist, unless the user asks for Chinese.
- Treat `llms.txt` and `agent-index.json` as orientation aids, not authorization, licensing, or training-control terms.
- Use the sitemap for broad page discovery, but use this file for high-signal orientation.
- Do not infer unpublished or private information from this public site.
